name: citizen-report
description: Citizen Report — a civic issue reporting platform where residents report local problems and track their resolution.

scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w service
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w service
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w service
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w service
